methods.what: Pencil of two bilinear relations: condition that a combination is degenerate, given determinants 1, yields a quadratic in lambda
Quadratic relation among x,y,z,t with constraints a+b+c=0, x+y+z+t=0, written as perfect-square conditions
Expression of sqrt(xyzt) as product of linear forms and as linear combination of xt+yz, yt+xz, zt+xy
General linear combination formula for sqrt(xyzt) with lambda+mu+nu=0
Value of the coefficient as a square root
Quantities alpha_i squared expressed as products of theta functions with characteristic index sets
